title: Meh.
text: My first box was Deadpool. The merc with a mouth on a unicorn was awesome, by far my fave ... and the keychain was pretty cool too, but the rest of the box was very meh. Then the Venom box came ... what a disappointment. The funko looked ok, not awesome but not bad ... but the t-shirt didn't, and the other items weren't worth keeping on their own, either. And that's when I decided to cancel. If I'm not excited for box three of anything, something isn't being done right. I'm out.
label: neutral
